description: Turns the entity's head toward targets set by look behaviors along the shortest arc in 3D, combining upward or downward rotation (pitch) with side-to-side rotation (yaw) in a single turn. Turn speed is the average of the pitch and yaw speeds supplied by the look behavior, optionally scaled by `reference_distance`. When no behavior requests a look target, the head keeps its current direction unless its pitch is outside `pitch_limits`, in which case it returns toward the nearest limit at `pitch_recovery_speed`.

pitch_limits.description: Allowed pitch in degrees, from -90 (straight up) to 90 (straight down). Set both limits to the same value for fixed pitch.
pitch_limits.x-runtime-constraint-description: Check that the limits imposed on the range (minimum, maximum and maximum distance between values) are respected

pitch_recovery_speed.description: Speed in degrees per second used to return the head's pitch to the nearest value within `pitch_limits` when no look request is present. Set to zero to disable idle pitch recovery. Does not limit turning toward requested targets.

reference_distance.description: Distance in blocks at or below which the look behavior's average pitch and yaw speed applies unchanged. Beyond this distance, turn speed is multiplied by `reference_distance` divided by the target distance. Distance is measured from the entity's breathing point to the requested look position. Applies only to position targets. Omit to disable distance scaling.

title: minecraft:spherical_look_control
